color.note: Two print runs. Papel: cream stock, a warm black key plate and two spot inks, vermilion and blue. Tinta: midnight stock, bone white and two fluorescent inks, pink and yellow. Every other color is a tint of those.

tokens.name: crema
tokens.usage: Primitive: the paper stock of the light run. Never pure white.

tokens.name: negro
tokens.usage: Primitive: the warm black of the key plate.

tokens.name: bermellon
tokens.usage: Primitive: the vermilion ink of the light run, deep enough for text on every paper.

tokens.name: azul
tokens.usage: Primitive: the printer's blue of the light run.

tokens.name: medianoche
tokens.usage: Primitive: the midnight stock of the dark run.

tokens.name: hueso
tokens.usage: Primitive: the bone white ink of the dark run.

tokens.name: rosa
tokens.usage: Primitive: fluorescent pink. Only on medianoche: it fails as text on a light paper.

tokens.name: amarillo
tokens.usage: Primitive: fluorescent yellow. Only on medianoche.

tokens.name: overprint
tokens.usage: The second ink of the theme's art: the plate printed out of register behind titles, and the overlapping shapes of the slots.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: the paper of each run.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, fields and the mobile tab bar: a lighter sheet pasted on the paper.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, figures and card covers: a heavier stock.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Fold lines and separators. Decorative: it does not delimit controls.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (fields, secondary button).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text, the borders of cards and the fill of the primary button: the key plate.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: excerpts, metadata, dates, help.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The first spot ink: accent button, eyebrows, active states.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: A light tint of the first ink: behind accent text, and the surface of a block with tone accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent on hover: a heavier pass in papel, a brighter one in tinta.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text: the second spot ink.

tokens.name: link-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background of links, highlights and active items.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset, in the second ink so it shows on accent fills too.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a success message.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning message.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always with an icon and a word: it is close to the accent.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error message.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informative state.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an informative message.

tokens.name: category-1
tokens.usage: Category 1: the first ink (vermilion, fluorescent pink).

tokens.name: category-1-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind category 1 text.

tokens.name: category-2
tokens.usage: Category 2: blue.

tokens.name: category-2-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind category 2 text.

tokens.name: category-3
tokens.usage: Category 3: green.

tokens.name: category-3-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind category 3 text.

tokens.name: category-4
tokens.usage: Category 4: ochre, orange.

tokens.name: category-4-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind category 4 text.

tokens.name: category-5
tokens.usage: Category 5: violet.

tokens.name: category-5-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind category 5 text.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Code text, on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Comments and punctuation in code.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords in code.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings in code.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers in code.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Function names in code.

shadow.note: Nothing glows and nothing blurs: a shadow is a plate printed out of register, and a ring is a rule of the second ink.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Raised cards: a second sheet of the first ink, offset and never blurred. Ink does not blur.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating controls over content: a hard offset sheet.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: The accent button on hover: the key plate shows behind it, out of register.

tokens.name: glow-link
tokens.usage: A hard ring of the second ink around a field that has the focus and around a tile under the pointer. The core gives comment fields no other focus indicator, so this is never none.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base 4px.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Padding between page sections.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Gap of card grids.

tokens.name: space-inline
tokens.usage: Side margin of the page; from 768px it centers the container.

radius.note: Cut paper has square corners. Only the dots are round.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tag marks, kbd and inline code: square.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and fields.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and the dots of the halftone.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a reading line.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Height of the header's main row in the bar layout.

motion.note: A poster does not move. The only motion is the press coming down: short and firm, under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

tokens.name: ease-emphasized
tokens.usage: A small overshoot, like a stamp landing.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Fallback", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
